senses.gloss:
m. (-रः)
A porpoise; more usually शिशुमार.

m. (-नः)
A dog.
E.
शुण to go, अच् aff.: see शुनि, श्वन्, &c.; also with कन् added शुनक.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Swelled, increased, grown.
2 Morbidly swollen.
f. (-ना)
1 A shambles, a slaughter-house.
2 The soft palate.
E.
श्वि to increase, aff. क्त, form irr.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Blown, budded, (as a flower.)
2 Empty, vacant.
3 Born, produced.
n. (-नं)
1 Bringing forth, (as young,) parturition.
2 A flower.
f. (-ना)
1 A daughter.
2 The uvula.
3 A shambles, a slaughter-house.
4 A place or utensil in a house, where, or by which, insects may be killed, as the hearth, the slab, the pestle and mortar, the broom, and the water-pot.
5 Hurting, injuring.
6 Inflammation of the glands of the neck.
7 A zone, a girdle.
8 A ray.
9 A river.
E.
षू to bear, &c., aff. क्त, or षु the same, न Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रः)
INDRA.
E.
सु good, venerable, नासीर van of his army, the स in each case changed; also शुनासीर, and more correctly, सुनासीर.

m. (-रः)
INDRA.
E.
सु good, excellent, नासीर the van of an army, the leader of the celestial hosts; also शुनासीर.

m. (-निः)
A dog.
f. (-नी)
A bitch.
E.
शुण to go, इक् aff. or श्वन् with ङीष् aff., and the semivowel changed

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Suckled by a bitch.
E.
शुनी, and धे to suck, खश् aff.

m. (-रः)
A number of dogs.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (शुन्धति-ते शुन्धयति-ते)
1 To be or become pure.
2 To cleanse, to purify.

m. (-न्ध्युः)
Fire.
E.
शुधि to purify, चुश् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
Empty, void.
n. (-न्यं)
1 A number of dogs.
2 A cypher.
E.
श्वन् a dog, and यत् aff., the vowel substituted for the semivowel, more commonly शून्य.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
1 Empty, void.
2 Lonely, desart.
n. (-न्यं)
1 Heaven, sky, æther.
2 A dot, a spot.
3 A cypher.
4 A vacuum.
f. (-न्या)
1 A hollow reed.
2 The prickly pear.
E.
शुन a dog, यत् aff. of fitness, and the vowel substituted for the semivowel, and made optionally long.

m. (-वान्)
A butcher, one who keeps a place where animals are killed for sale.
E.
शूना a shambles, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Budding.
2 Bearing.
E.
षू to bear, क्तवतु aff.

n. (-हं)
An empty or deserted house.
E.
शून्य, and गेह a house.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Vacuity, emptiness.
2 Unreality, the false or illusory nature of all existence.
E.
त्व added to शून्य; also with तल्, शून्यता.

m. (-ध्यः)
A hollow reed.
E.
शून्य empty, and मध्य the middle.

m. (-दी)
1 A Bauddha.
2 An atheist.
E.
शून्य vacuum, and वादिन् declaring; denying the existence of any thing.

n. (-नं)
An empty place.
E.
शून्य, and स्थान place.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Empty-handed.
E.
शून्य, and हस्त the hand.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
Pleasing, delighting.
n. (-न्दं)
The club of BALARĀMA.
f. (-न्दा)
1 The goddess UMĀ.
2 A sort of pigment and drug: see गोरोचना.
3 A woman.
4 One of UMĀ'S female companions.
5 A plant, (Aristolochia Indica.)
E.
सु well, thoroughly, नदि to please, aff. अच्.

m. (-यः)
1 Policy.
2 Good conduct.
E.
सु, and णी to take, अच् aff.

m. (-नः)
A deer.
f. (-ना)
A woman.
E.
सु good, excellent, and नयन the eye.

m. (-तः)
Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.)

m. (-भः)
A mountain; part of the ranges of southern India, personified as the son of Himālaya, and Menā.
E.
सु well, नाभि the navel.

m. (-रः)
1 The udder of a bitch.
2 The egg of a snake.
3 A sparrow.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.)

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Easily restrained.
E.
सु, and निग्रह confinement.

f. (-द्रा)
Sound sleep.
E.
सु, and निद्रा sleep.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Very lonely or private.
E.
सु, and निभृत lonely.

ind.
Privately, very secretly.
E.
सु, and निभृतम् privately.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well observed or inspected.
E.
सु, and निरूपित seen.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Ascertained, determined.
2 Commended, approved.
m. (-तः)
A deified sage, according to the Jainas or Bauddhas.
E.
सु well, thoroughly, and निश्चित ascertained.

n. (-कं)
A potherb, (Marsilia quadrifolia.)
E.
सु well, निषण्ण depression of spirits or drowsiness, कन् aff.; also without the final, सुनिषण्ण.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Burnished.
E.
सु well, thoroughly, and निष्टप्त heated.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Well behaved.
2 Politic.
n. (-तं)
1 Good conduct.
2 Policy.
E.
सु well, णी to guide, क्त aff.

f. (-तिः)
1 Propriety of behaviour, good manners.
2 The mother of DHRUVA.
E.
सु good, excellent, and नीति morals or manners.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
Virtuous, moral, good, of proper disposition or conduct.
E.
सु well, नी to obtain, aff. थक्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Very black or blue, dark.
m. (-लः)
The pomegranate tree.
n. (-लं)
The root of the Andropogon muricatum.
E.
सु much, नील blue or black.

m. (-कः)
1 The blue shrike.
2 The emerald or sapphire.
E.
सु very, नील blue or black, कन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा or -री-रं)
Handsome, beautiful.
m. (-रः)
KĀMADEVA.
f. (-री)
1 A handsome woman.
2 A small timber tree, (Heritiera minor.)
3 Turmeric.
4 A species of metre.
E.
सु good, excellent, दृ to respect, aff. अप्; or सु, with उन्दि to moisten, aff. अरन्.

mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वती-न्वत्)
Sacrificing, offering sacrifice.
E.
षुञ् to sacrifice, and शतृ aff.

m. (-नी)
A butcher, a hunter, one who practices the death of animals.
E.
सूना a slaughter-house, इनि aff.

m. (-नुः)
1 A son.
2 A younger brother.
3 The sun.
4 A daughter's son.
f. (-नुः or -नूः)
A daughter.
E.
षू to bear, (as children,) नु Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 True.
2 Fortunate, auspicious.
3 Agreeable, pleasant, (as speech.)
4 Dear to, beloved by.
n. (-तं)
Agreeable discourse or speech, but also true.
E.
सु well, नृत to dance, (or excel,) घञ् aff., and the vowel of the prefix made long.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Mad, crazy, insane.
E.
सु much, उन्मद mad.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Mad, insane.
E.
सु much, उन्माद madness, (whose.)
